_comment: Shared golden cases for the whole KPI calculation (calculation version 1), beyond the single achievements of kpi-calculation-cases.json.
The API runs every case against KpiCalculator and KpiFigures (Apex.Hrms.Application.Tests, KpiScorecardCasesTests); the Angular demo mock is meant to run the same file. Fictional figures only.

Shape: { _comment, cases: Case[] }. Every case has a unique 'name' and a 'kind'; the other fields depend on the kind. Numbers are plain JSON numbers (decimals in the API, two decimals unless stated); texts are the API's enum texts.
Rule (as in kpi-calculation-cases.json): { measurementType, direction, scoringMethod, target, rangeMin, rangeMax, maxRating, maxAchievementPct } (null where unused).
Error: { message, fieldErrors: { <field>: [<message>, ...] } }: the AppError of a 400; fieldErrors lists every field key the API answers with its messages.

kind 'score' (KpiCalculator.Score): input items: [{ rule, weight, actual (null = no result) }] in scorecard order. Expected: either expected { items: [{ achievementPct, weightedScore }], overallScore } or expectedError. Each weighted score is achievement x weight / 100 rounded to 2 decimals (away from zero) and the overall score is the sum of the rounded weighted scores. The weights are checked first, then the missing results, then each KPI in order.
kind 'validateWeights' (KpiCalculator.ValidateWeights): input weights: number[]. Expected: valid true, or valid false with expectedError (only the first problem is reported).

kind 'ratingLabel' (KpiCalculator.RatingLabel): input overallScore and bands: [{ minScore, label }] in any order. Expected: expectedLabel, the label of the highest minScore the score reaches, or null.
kind 'average' (KpiFigures.Average): input sum (null = no values) and count. Expected: expected = sum / count rounded to 2 decimals away from zero, or null when count is 0.

kind 'completionRate' (KpiFigures.CompletionRate): input finalized and evaluated (scorecards past Planning). Expected: expected = finalized x 100 / evaluated rounded to 2 decimals away from zero, 0 when evaluated is 0.

kind 'competitionRanks' (KpiFigures.CompetitionRanks): input scoresDescending (one page, highest first), firstRank (the rank of the first score) and firstPosition (its 1-based position in the whole ranking). Expected: expected = the rank of each score (standard competition ranking: equal scores share a rank, the next rank skips).
kind 'attentionThreshold' (KpiFigures.AttentionThreshold): input activeBandMinScores. Expected: expected = the lowest minScore that is at least 60, or 60 when there is none.
